summary: Nexalin Technology, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 1.01 to report a Third Amendment to its office lease with Nutex HQ LLC, covering its Houston headquarters. The amendment extends the lease term by 65 months, expands space by 904 rentable square feet to about 4,527, and sets monthly base rent between approximately $5,470 and $6,413, with a five-month abatement after expansion delivery. No securities, special-situation financing, or structural corporate event was involved; this is a routine operational lease agreement. Watch for the exhibit filing with the next 10-Q, but no risk-arb or special-situation angle applies.
